name: Maison Delano Paris
positioning: Hotel in an 18th century mansion in the heart of Paris's 8th Arrondissement, with historic suites and a courtyard restaurant
best_for: Travelers who want historic suites with painted ceilings and balconies over the Faubourg Saint-Honore
Families or groups who need connecting suites

facts.text: Maison Delano Paris is located in the heart of the 8th Arrondissement.
The hotel has a Parisian courtyard of an 18th century mansion.
Rooms are appointed with modern furnishings in a neutral palette layered with olive green hues, ethereal curtains and contemporary artwork.
The Presidential Suite combines the two largest suites at the hotel and has soaring frescoed ceilings.
The Grand Prestige Suite has restored painted ceilings and original 18th-century mouldings.
The Grand Prestige Suite can be connected to the Grand Historic Suite to create a two-bedroom suite.
The Deluxe Suite has a separate living room and overlooks the hotel's inner courtyard.
Prestige Rooms overlook either the city streets or the hotel's historic courtyard.
Rooms have MALIN+GOETZ bath amenities and Tessicasa linen bedding.
The concierge can arrange in-room massages, a hair stylist on demand and airport transfers.

highlights.text: The Grand Historic Suite has herringbone parquet flooring, original painted ceilings, marble fireplaces and a balcony overlooking the Faubourg Saint-Honore.
The Grand Prestige Suite has a second-floor balcony with views over the Faubourg Saint-Honore.
The Presidential Suite features original marble fireplaces, painted ceilings and intricate mouldings.
Delano Cafe is a French-Mediterranean restaurant in the historic hotel courtyard.

considerations.text: Parking at the hotel is paid.
Pets can be accommodated for additional fees.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
